description: Ordered, first-match inventory rules. Categories describe provenance, not permission to delete. Unknown files require review.

rules.reason: Motion paths are inputs to concept viewers, even under review directories.
Promoted actuator STEP solids are canonical design inputs.
Canonical V3 build imports this approved TPU clip mesh as source geometry.
Start, experiment, physical-observation or outcome record; preserve and inspect its contents before interpreting it as physical validation.
Recorded print job inputs, profiles or layout; preserve with the exact job package.
Job artifact or generated viewer data; preserve the exact printed package and do not remove before an audit.
Generated README preview or render; verify its dependencies before changing it.
Reference images, measurements and supporting material preserve design context.
Concept illustrations and their specification sidecars preserve user requirements.
Geometry in a source directory may be an input; establish provenance and dependencies before changing it.
Concept geometry may be a source input or review export; inspect before changing it.
Review metadata may contain source inputs, validation results or experiment context; inspect before changing it.
Review or manufacturing output; may be intentionally tracked or needed by viewers, so preserve until audited.
Geometry or manufacturing file with uncertain provenance; inspect before changing it.
Documentation or configuration retained for project context.

fallback.reason: No explicit rule matches; inspect provenance and dependencies. Never infer deletion from this category.
